title: Bridging Behavioral Gaps: Automatic Extrapolation of Concreteness Norms for Arabic and English with a k-Nearest Neighbor Approach

live_model.evidence: Sec 4.5/5.5: "we obtained ratings from GPT-o4-mini (2025-04-16) by prompting it ... instructed to return a single integer (1-5) at zero-temperature"; Table 6 English Spearman=0.804, RMSE=0.669
